normalization_steps: Left-pad state code to two digits
Left-pad county code to three digits
Concatenate into a five-character county FIPS
Align county-boundary and code vintages before joining

preconditions: Verify state_code and county_code are present in the selected CMS POS release
caveats: Current field presence was not live verified in this offline corpus.
County boundaries and FIPS codes can change across vintages.
A geographic join does not establish facility identity.

normalization_steps: Normalize whitespace and punctuation only in comparison fields
Require human review for collisions and unmatched rows

preconditions: Review mergers, renames, relocations, and campuses manually
caveats: Name-and-state matching is heuristic and must never be promoted to exact identity.
Hospitals may have multiple CCNs, campuses, aliases, or ownership changes.
Closure and POS dates must be aligned before interpreting status differences.

normalization_steps: Do not compare the two namespaces directly
Obtain an evidence-bound AHA-ID to CCN crosswalk
Version and retain the crosswalk separately

preconditions: Obtain authorization for the licensed AHA asset
caveats: AHA IDs and CMS CCNs are different namespaces.
Facility names are not a substitute for a documented crosswalk.
Systems, hospitals, campuses, and provider numbers do not necessarily share one-to-one cardinality.
blocked_reason: The published offline corpus contains no evidence-bound AHA-ID to CMS-CCN crosswalk.
